Runs a real Rocq kernel (a js_of_ocaml build of rocq-runtime 9.2 + rocq-comparator) inside a Web Worker in your browser — no source ever leaves your machine. The kernel-level checks (AST filter, statement comparison, dependency closure, assumption analysis) all run client-side. Serve locally with python3 -m http.server 8000 (or any static file server) from this directory, then open http://localhost:8000/ — a same-origin server is needed because the engine loads inside a Web Worker. Opening index.html as a file:// URL still shows the UI and the demo-verdict buttons (which need no worker). This build currently runs with -noinit: no Corelib prelude .vo bundle is shipped yet, so proofs use core Gallina only. See BACKEND.md for the prelude-bundle plan.
